result_rule: Every ON window requires UV attempts >0, witness_ok >0, published_records >0 and pak records/basis ready >0. Any zero fails this publication hypothesis; UV-only candidates never qualify. No promotion or visual/energy/GPU-cost claim.
window_bound: 120-frame producer with rt_stats; cp4 observed 240 frames in 16.020 s, or 8.010 s per line. Rounded 9 s period plus 1 s settings latency and one straddling line requires >19 s; both ON windows are 19.1 s.
offline_status: Host build and 7/7 focused CTests pass; production ring replay covers match, mismatch, budgets, chunks, discarded submissions and reuse. live_flow preflight passes (1 job, 0 failures). Historical publish-audit.json remains the sampled-only baseline.
